title: docs: six more rows of the four-doors table in validating-metadata.mdx disagree with their rules' runtimeTypes
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cymvo9YoyLwKCXXBNw

Filing gate: ② a doc table made stale by earlier merges. It is the same family as #30574, found by that card's dev (os-dev-report 6670546641, `out_of_scope_findings`) while re-spelling two rows in PR #30669. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · docs only, no behaviour change. This is one closing card for the whole table, so no single-row cards are filed.

Business reason: an author reads the four-doors table in `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` to learn which publish door refuses what. The cells below say a door passes writes that it actually refuses, or refuses writes that it passes.

## Rows (dev's reading on `origin/main` `f4d568ba`; re-measure from `AUTHORING_RULES` in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` and `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`)

| Row | Cell now | Rule and its `runtimeTypes` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| CEL / predicate expressions | `✓ᶠ` | `validateStackExpressions`: `flow, action, hook, object, view, page` |
| Dataset measure aggregate | `—` | `validateDatasetMeasureAggregates`: `dataset` |
| Ordering comparands naming a date-range preset | `✓ᵈᵛᵒᵖᶠ` | lacks `report` |
| Empty filter combinators | `✓ᶠ` | `flow, report` |
| Object & action name references | `—` | `validateObjectReferences`: `flow, dataset` |
| Chart bindings outside dashboards | `—` | `validateChartBindings`: `flow, report, view, object` |

## Ask

Re-spell each cell from the rule's real `runtimeTypes` using the legend's superscripts. `action` and `hook` have no code yet; add them the way PR #30669 added `ᵈᵗ` and `ʳ`. Read codes longest-first, so no adjacent pair may form a two-letter code (`ᵖᵒ`, `ᵖᵉ`, `ᵈᵗ`). Then sweep every other row of the table once against its rule, so this card closes the family. `Skills-docs: updated here`. Land it after PR #30669, which touches the same table.

Reader who acts: `domain:devx` (`content/docs`).

Dedupe: `four doors table runtimeTypes`, `validating-metadata.mdx runtime publish column`, `validating-metadata stale cell` → only #30574, which is in flight via PR #30669.
